issue.body:
As part of our goal to modernize and type our core components, we need to migrate off of `createReactClass`. This task is to track the work to remove `createReactClass` from our codebase.

We can only convert off of `createReactClass` if the components don't use any mixins. [Step 1](https://github.com/facebook/react-native/issues/21342) and [Step 2](https://github.com/facebook/react-native/issues/21485) were removing a few of the mixins. There are still a few mixins left and we will need to completely finish that before we can complete this issue. 

However, we can at least get started by removing `createReactClass` from the components that currently don't use any mixins. The following is that list:

- [x] ReactAndroid/src/androidTest/js/ScrollViewTestModule.js
- [x] ReactAndroid/src/androidTest/js/UIManagerTestModule.js
- [x] RNTester/js/ListViewExample.js
- [x] RNTester/js/ImageExample.js
- [x] RNTester/js/TimerExample.js
- [x] RNTester/js/TextExample.ios.js
- [x] RNTester/js/ProgressBarAndroidExample.android.js
- [x] RNTester/js/PanResponderExample.js
- [x] RNTester/js/ListViewGridLayoutExample.js
- [x] RNTester/js/SwipeableFlatListExample.js
- [x] RNTester/js/ProgressViewIOSExample.js
- [x] RNTester/js/CameraRollView.js
- [x] IntegrationTests/LayoutEventsTest.js
- [x] IntegrationTests/ReactContentSizeUpdateTest.js
- [x] Libraries/Experimental/SwipeableRow/SwipeableRow.js

I got this list by running `grep -L "mixins:" $(grep -l -r createReactClass .)`. None of these files seem to be convertible by the [codemod provided by the react team](https://github.com/reactjs/react-codemod#explanation-of-the-new-es2015-class-transform-with-property-initializers).

I'm providing less instructions on this one because I think there are a lot of posts online about how to convert off of `createReactClass`.
